automatic_review.scope: Entry-reachable direct CFG correspondence under the listed exact-name/import/function-address identities. Ignore architectural no-ops and direct internal jump trampolines; preserve ordinary operations, registers, operand widths, prefixes and edge predicates, including paired inverse predicates. Shared/duplicated tails may correlate to the same instructions. This is structural evidence, not execution, callee/data-content equivalence, literal pointer-identity proof or a whole-game proof. Read-only C-string and declared DIALOG-token mappings compare complete contents through NUL, not storage identity, alias relationships or bytes beyond the terminator. Arbitrary PC/return-address inspection is outside this review. Calls are followed through normal returns only; exception/unwind/longjmp edges are not covered. Indirect jumps are refused. Unsupported operation, register, address and width differences remain unresolved. Raw scores and discovery differences are unchanged; current native/rebuilt ranges are pinned. Swapped global/stack-parameter equality loads may differ in EAX and non-ZF flags: the unequal successor must overwrite/clobber EAX before any read and discard comparison flags before any use. On the equal successor both loads yield identical EAX, and subtracting equal 32-bit operands gives identical CMP flags. Requires an ordinary disjoint C stack and global memory without concurrent mutation, MMIO, read-order-sensitive faults or asynchronous observation. Only named cross-CU cdecl calls are accepted as EAX/flag clobbers; unknown/inline register-argument calls remain unresolved. A single XOR EAX,EAX may move among an identical ordered sequence of 32-bit stack restores ending in a plain RET. No EAX reads/restores, flag consumers, memory writes, calls or conditional branches are accepted in those suffixes. Requires the ordinary C return ABI with EFLAGS unobserved after return and valid stack accesses; exceptions, asynchronous/intermediate state inspection and fault-order equivalence are outside this check. For functions with a current plain C void declaration and a named native C DWARF definition lacking any direct or inherited return type, equality scratch EAX may remain live only until an unprefixed operand-free RET. It still must not affect a memory address, store, argument, branch or any other instruction before return. Flags and ordinary operation/side-effect matching retain their existing checks. Return-register contents and EFLAGS are unobserved by the ordinary C void-return ABI; integer/pointer results and unknown declarations receive no relaxation. Optional pointer suffixes use structural symbolic expressions and equality decision trees, under native DWARF 32-bit pointer returns and matching current C char-pointer declarations. Only read-only MOV/extension/LEA/register AND/zero XOR/CMP/TEST, direct JE/JNE/internal JMP and ordinary stack restores/plain RET are supported. EAX, callee-saved registers and final ESP must agree on every modeled path. ECX, EDX and EFLAGS are caller-saved and unobserved after the ordinary C pointer return. Calls, stores, prefixes, cycles, other predicates/operations and state limits remain unresolved. Requires valid ordinary memory reads without concurrent mutation, volatile/MMIO effects, asynchronous intermediate observation or read/fault-order inspection; address/literal correspondences retain the assumptions above. No solver or sampled-input inference is used.

compiler_split_worker.scope: The native full helper is compared to GCC current miara_trigger.isra.0.part.0. Its positive-count body has strict entry-reachable CFG correspondence under the named callee/global identities. Both current direct calls pass 1..255 in EDX; mask/branch dominance and absence of alternate guard entries are checked. The source still contains its amount<1 guard. Raw E8/E9 scanning of executable sections finds only these two direct worker references, each verified as decoded calls; the source is static with two call expressions and no registered assembly entry. This explains the missing entry guard in this comparison, not whole-game or arbitrary indirect/exceptional entry behavior. Callee identities, ordinary C/ABI execution, valid memory and normal-return edges remain assumptions. No source change or rebuild.

manual_argument_reviews.name: card_paragon_of_the_amesha
manual_argument_reviews.reason: Native writes the pump_ability_until_eot result from EAX to outgoing card slot ESP+4 immediately, then saves it in callee-saved EDI. Rebuilt saves it in EDI first and writes that same result to ESP+4 later while preparing the parent-controller argument. Only MOV instructions intervene before the identical get_card_instance call; no callback or differing store changes the result. Later add_status also uses the same saved EDI. This is argument preparation ordering, not a changed helper argument.
